newsitem.title: INDIA: Sixteen Indians die after drinking illicit liquor.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen Indians die after drinking illicit liquor.

text.p: At least 16 people died and 50 were taken to hospital in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu after drinking illicit liquor, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported on Sunday.
Quoting local authorities, PTI said 68 people drank the liquor on Saturday night in the Pudukottai district, 350 km (220 miles) from the Madras.
A government official said the liquor was mixed with varnish. Police have arrested the owners of the liquor shop.
Hundreds of people, mostly poor, die every year in India after consuming cheap illicit liquor.
